zh: 历史快照明细去重存储：数据导入保存的快照不再每份都内嵌全部源表行，相同内容的表只按内容压缩保存一份，两张快照表共用；按 30 天每日导入模拟，快照占用从约 349 MB 降到约 20 MB。旧快照在后台逐条转换，每条先校验能完整还原再写回；读取、月报资料库、指标溯源与导出备份包的数据与以前一致。
en: Deduplicated snapshot detail storage: data-import snapshots no longer embed every source row in each copy; identical tables are compressed and stored once, shared by both snapshot tables. In a 30-day daily-import simulation snapshot storage dropped from about 349 MB to about 20 MB. Older snapshots are converted in the background one at a time after verifying they restore exactly; reads, the monthly report library, metric lineage and exported backup packages return the same data as before.
